title: An Ambiguity Measure for Recognizing the Unknowns in Deep Learning
reasoning: The paper's motivation and examples, such as autonomous driving and clinical decisions for patients, directly address the ethical implications and safety concerns when AI models are uncertain or make mistakes in high-stakes scenarios. The proposed ambiguity measure aims to enable models to 'know what it does not know' to make more conservative decisions or abstain, thus improving reliability in ethically sensitive applications.
